Reason for Mistake: The Planner fixated on Taylor Swift’s “Safe & Sound,” incorrectly asserted it was directed by Roman White, and then prematurely eliminated Taylor Swift as the answer. This ignored clear evidence from earlier search results that Yoann Lemoine (Woodkid) directed Taylor Swift’s “Back to December,” an orchestral country-pop ballad matching the prompt. By overlooking this and pivoting to Harry Styles, the Planner misidentified the correct top pop artist (Taylor Swift).
